No. I'm guessing you're referring to Roundup Ready, one type of GM crop that is resistant to glyphosate (an herbicide). Without Roundup Ready crops, farmers would still use herbicides. Instead of a broad spectrum herbicide like glyphosate for both corn and soybeans, they would use 2,4-D on corn and Benzaton on soybeans.

Organic food won't save you either. Organic farmers are allowed to use pesticides that are naturally occurring (but not identical compounds that are synthesized, oddly enough). But just because something is natural doesn't mean that it's safe; plenty of natural substances are toxic to people too. For example, Rotenone is a very effective organic pesticide that is actually toxic to humans (and all animals) that is still allowed on organic farms (not in the US anymore as the EPA has banned it but any organic food from international sources could still be treated with Rotenone).

tl,dr Your food is treated with plenty of chemicals, regardless of source. Just because something is toxic to plants doesn't make it unsafe for you.
